answer_1.quote: In simultaneous speech translation (SimulST), systems have to generate translations incrementally while concurrently receiving audio input.

answer_2.quote: We use sacreBLEU to evaluate translation quality, and Average Lagging (AL) to evaluate latency, as in the default SimulEval evaluation setup. As suggested by, for our comparisons with other approaches we also report computational-aware average lagging (AL_CA)... Results with other metrics, DAL and LAAL, are provided in Appendix C for completeness.
